metadata.question: Does forest cover in the Madre de Dios region of Peru decrease in 2018 compared to 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Madre de Dios region, Peru (approximately -11.5 to -13.5 lat, -69 to -72 lon) - Time: Two comparison points - 2013 and 2018 (full years) - Collection: Use Hansen Global Forest Change or MODIS land cover for forest detection - Hansen dataset provides annual forest loss, so we can calculate forest cover for both years 2. Masking strategy: - Hansen dataset doesn't require cloud masking (it's a composite product) - Use treecover2000 band and subtract losses up to each year - Forest cover 2013 = treecover2000 - loss(2001-2013) - Forest cover 2018 = treecover2000 - loss(2001-2018) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid comparison: Both years have forest area values > 0 - C3: If either calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values - A: If 2018 forest cover < 2013 forest cover (decrease) - B: If 2018 forest cover >= 2013 forest cover (no decrease) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions # Madre de Dios region, Peru madre_de_dios = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-72.5, -13.5], [-72.5, -11.0], [-68.5, -11.0], [-68.5, -13.5], [-72.5, -13.5]] ]) # 2. Data Acquisition - Hansen Global Forest Change hansen = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1_11') # Get relevant bands treecover2000 = hansen.select('treecover2000') loss = hansen.select('loss') lossyear = hansen.select('lossyear') # 3. Calculate forest cover for 2013 and 2018 # Forest pixels with >30% tree cover in 2000 forest_mask = treecover2000.gte(30) # Create loss masks for each year # lossyear: 1=2001, 2=2002, ..., 13=2013, ..., 18=2018 loss_by_2013 = lossyear.lte(13).And(loss.eq(1)) loss_by_2018 = lossyear.lte(18).And(loss.eq(1)) # Forest remaining in 2013 and 2018 forest_2013 = forest_mask.And(loss_by_2013.Not()) forest_2018 = forest_mask.And(loss_by_2018.Not()) # 4. Calculate forest areas area_image = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6) # Convert to km² forest_area_2013 = area_image.updateMask(forest_2013).reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=madre_de_dios, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('area') forest_area_2018 = area_image.updateMask(forest_2018).reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=madre_de_dios, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('area') # Get pixel counts for validation count_2013 = forest_2013.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=madre_de_dios, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('treecover2000') count_2018 = forest_2018.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=madre_de_dios, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('treecover2000') # 5. Get values and validate area_2013 = forest_area_2013.getInfo() area_2018 = forest_area_2018.getInfo() pixels_2013 = count_2013.getInfo() pixels_2018 = count_2018.getInfo() print(f"Forest Area 2013: {area_2013:.2f} km² (Pixels: {int(pixels_2013)})") print(f"Forest Area 2018: {area_2018:.2f} km² (Pixels: {int(pixels_2018)})") # Validation & Final Answer if area_2013 is None or area_2018 is None or pixels_2013 == 0 or pixels_2018 == 0: print("Calculation failed or no valid pixels") print("C3") elif area_2018 < area_2013: decrease = area_2013 - area_2018 percent_decrease = (decrease / area_2013) * 100 print(f"Forest Decrease: {decrease:.2f} km² ({percent_decrease:.2f}%)") print("A") else: print("No decrease in forest cover") print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Madre de Dios region, Peru
madre_de_dios = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[-72.5, -13.5], [-72.5, -11.0], [-68.5, -11.0], [-68.5, -13.5], [-72.5, -13.5]]
])

# 2. Data Acquisition - Hansen Global Forest Change
hansen = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1_11')

# Get relevant bands
treecover2000 = hansen.select('treecover2000')
loss = hansen.select('loss')
lossyear = hansen.select('lossyear')

# 3. Calculate forest cover for 2013 and 2018
# Forest pixels with >30% tree cover in 2000
forest_mask = treecover2000.gte(30)

# Create loss masks for each year
# lossyear: 1=2001, 2=2002, ..., 13=2013, ..., 18=2018
loss_by_2013 = lossyear.lte(13).And(loss.eq(1))
loss_by_2018 = lossyear.lte(18).And(loss.eq(1))

# Forest remaining in 2013 and 2018
forest_2013 = forest_mask.And(loss_by_2013.Not())
forest_2018 = forest_mask.And(loss_by_2018.Not())

# 4. Calculate forest areas
area_image = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6)  # Convert to km²

forest_area_2013 = area_image.updateMask(forest_2013).reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry=madre_de_dios,
    scale=3000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('area')

forest_area_2018 = area_image.updateMask(forest_2018).reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry=madre_de_dios,
    scale=3000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('area')

# Get pixel counts for validation
count_2013 = forest_2013.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=madre_de_dios,
    scale=3000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('treecover2000')

count_2018 = forest_2018.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=madre_de_dios,
    scale=3000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('treecover2000')

# 5. Get values and validate
area_2013 = forest_area_2013.getInfo()
area_2018 = forest_area_2018.getInfo()
pixels_2013 = count_2013.getInfo()
pixels_2018 = count_2018.getInfo()

print(f"Forest Area 2013: {area_2013:.2f} km² (Pixels: {int(pixels_2013)})")
print(f"Forest Area 2018: {area_2018:.2f} km² (Pixels: {int(pixels_2018)})")

# Validation & Final Answer
if area_2013 is None or area_2018 is None or pixels_2013 == 0 or pixels_2018 == 0:
    print("Calculation failed or no valid pixels")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif area_2018 < area_2013:
    decrease = area_2013 - area_2018
    percent_decrease = (decrease / area_2013) * 100
    print(f"Forest Decrease: {decrease:.2f} km² ({percent_decrease:.2f}%)")
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("No decrease in forest cover")
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
